summary.headline: Turin Codex: Astrology and Astronomy
summary.text: Catalogue of a Turin codex section containing colored astronomical figures, judicial astrology, methods for zodiacal and planetary horoscopy, planetary days and hours with tables, lunar methods, and zodiacal year rulership. It also records a dialogue on fasting, Isaac Argyrus’s Persian astronomical tables, Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos, and later astronomical fragments with tables.
